title: PRD: Add incident-derived synthetic validation harness and tenant-level fallback contracts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: A recent KV cache stall incident highlighted gaps between our operational runbooks and the PRD: missing synthetic validation coverage for cache regen flows, unclear tenant fallback budgets, and weak canary sentinels. This ticket captures product requirements to translate the postmortem actions into concrete PRD changes that engineering and ops can implement and test. Goal: Add a synthetic validation harness that simulates cache regen and coldstart traffic, codify tenant-level fallback budgets and eviction priorities, and define canary sentinels and rollback gates tied to SLOs. Deliverables should be implementation-agnostic requirements, acceptance criteria, and a verification plan for release owners and SREs.
acceptance_criteria: A1: PRD includes a test matrix mapping postmortem scenarios to synthetic validation cases (kV cache rehydrate, coldstart surge, kernel regression) with expected pass/fail thresholds.
A2: Tenant fallback contract defined: per-tenant fallback budget (tokens/min and percentile tail-latency threshold), eviction priority policy, and operator-visible flags for forced fallback/eviction.
A3: Canary plan specified: staged traffic percentages, sentinel metrics (tail P99.9 latency, error-rate-by-route, model-compatibility-errors), and automatic rollback criteria wired to release gates.

A4: Runbook requirements added: exact steps for KV cache regen (priming order, traffic shepherding steps, monitoring dashboards to validate regen), with links to required dashboards and runbook owners.

A5: Verification harness: an acceptance test suite definition that can be executed in CI or on a canary cluster that reproduces the synthetic scenarios and returns pass/fail artifacts to the release checklist.
A6: Telemetry and alerting spec included: required metrics, tagging (tenant_id, route, model_variant), and alert thresholds to trigger incident runbook and automatic fallback paths.
A7: Security and compliance notes: any data used in synthetic validation must be sanitized and KMS usage for secret rotation is documented (security review flagged if necessary).
tasks: Draft PRD section mapping each postmortem action item to a scannable requirement (owner: PM)
Define synthetic test cases and pass/fail criteria with SRE (owner: SRE lead)
Specify tenant fallback budget policy and eviction ordering format (owner: Platform PM)
Enumerate canary sentinel metrics and rollback gates with engineering (owner: ENG lead)
Link required dashboards and add new panels for regen verification (owner: Observability)
Add verification checklist to release playbook and CI job placeholders (owner: Release Eng)
Coordinate security review if synthetic traffic uses real customer data (owner: Security)
Review PRD with oncall and SRE rotation for feedback, capture signoffs (owner: PM)
Publish PRD updates and notify stakeholders: Eng, SRE, Console, Support (owner: PM)
Track implementation tickets and verify acceptance criteria during canary (owner: PM)
